meta.name: fluidsim
meta.description: Plan, configure, inspect, restart, and analyze bounded FluidSim computational-fluid-dynamics simulations with explicit numerical-validity and HPC safety checks. Use for FluidSim solver selection, parameter review, FFT/MPI setup, output diagnostics, or restart compatibility.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 规划配置计算流体动力学仿真，进行数值有效性与HPC安全检查
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你在做流体动力学仿真，需要确保计算参数有效
copy.tagline_en: Plan, configure, and analyze FluidSim CFD simulations with validity and HPC safety checks
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you conduct fluid dynamics simulations and need to ensure numerical validity and HPC safety

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会帮你规划、配置、检查、重启和分析 FluidSim 流体动力学模拟，并执行数值有效性与 HPC 安全检查。它会给出 Python 代码来设置参数、运行模拟、绘制涡量/能谱等结果。
howto.when: 当你想运行流体动力学模拟（如二维/三维 Navier-Stokes、浅水方程、分层流），或涉及 FluidSim 求解器选择、参数检查、FFT/MPI 配置、输出诊断、重启兼容性时触发。

say.text: 帮我用 ns2d 求解器配置 256x256 的二维湍流模拟并运行
say.note: Claude 会生成参数配置和运行代码。

say.text: 我的 FluidSim 模拟想用 MPI 并行，给出 mpirun 命令
say.note: Claude 会提供并行运行方案。

say.text: 检查一下这个 params 对象，数值有效性设置有没有问题
say.note: Claude 会逐项核查参数并给出建议。

howto.what_en: Claude helps plan, configure, inspect, restart, and analyze FluidSim CFD simulations with numerical-validity and HPC safety checks, giving Python code for parameters, execution, and output plots (vorticity, spectra).
howto.when_en: Triggers when running fluid dynamics simulations (2D/3D Navier-Stokes, shallow water, stratified flows) or when working on FluidSim solver selection, parameter review, FFT/MPI setup, output diagnostics, or restart compatibility.

say_en.text: Configure a 256x256 2D turbulence run with ns2d and execute it.
say_en.note: Claude will generate params and run code.

say_en.text: I want MPI parallel for my FluidSim simulation. Give the mpirun command.
say_en.note: Claude will provide a parallel execution setup.

say_en.text: Check my params object for numerical validity issues and fix them.
say_en.note: Claude will review the parameters and suggest corrections.
